tags.name: arkham
tags.description: On-chain intelligence platform. Tracks wallet ownership, entity attribution, and fund flows across 30+ blockchains. Data covers exchanges, protocols, funds, and labeled addresses. Provides transfer history, portfolio timeseries, token holders, DEX screener, Polymarket positions, and Hypercore perp data.

tags.name: debank
tags.description: Portfolio tracker for Ethereum and EVM chains. Anonymous web API with a static API key issued to all visitors plus per-request HMAC-SHA256 signing (x-api-sign). Covers balances, portfolio apps, net-worth history, user profiles, followers and chain metadata.

tags.name: defillama
tags.description: Open DeFi analytics: total-value-locked rankings across thousands of protocols and chains, protocol TVL history, token prices (current, historical, first-seen), stablecoin supply and flows, yield-bearing pool rankings with APY history, and per-protocol DEX volumes / fees / revenue / emissions summaries. All routes are the documented free, no-auth surfaces of api.llama.fi, coins.llama.fi, stablecoins.llama.fi and yields.llama.fi.

tags.name: dexscreener
tags.description: Real-time DEX market data across 70+ blockchains: pair discovery, prices, liquidity, volume, transaction counts, market caps, token profiles, boosts and trending narratives (metas). The default client uses the documented public API; a small set of additional UNOFFICIAL web-only routes (extended pair detail, reactions, chain registry), reconstructed from browser traffic and not part of the documented API, is available under the /web/ path prefix.

tags.name: dextools
tags.description: DEX analytics platform covering 75+ blockchains: trending pairs, new pool listings, token search, pair and token detail with DEXT scores, holders, top traders, liquidity providers, and global market metrics. The default surface is the public web API used by the site itself; the documented developer API is available under the /official/ prefix with a DEXTOOLS_API_KEY credential.

tags.name: dzap
tags.description: DZap is a cross-chain swap and bridge aggregator (app.dzap.io) with a second 'zapping' surface for DeFi positions. This source exposes the anonymous read surface the public web app itself uses: the chain registry with per-chain contracts, per-chain token registries and token metadata, the provider catalog (which DEX/bridge serves which chain), swap/bridge quote discovery with per-provider output amounts and fees, the campaign feed, the DCA token list, and the zapping pool/provider catalogs.

tags.name: geckoterminal
tags.description: Multi-network DEX market data from the CoinGecko team: pools, tokens, prices, volume, liquidity, OHLCV candles, trades, trending and new pools across 1,900+ DEXes on 248 networks. The default face is the p1 web surface (app.geckoterminal.com/api/p1): unified search, global stats, trends, trending themes and a richer per-network pools listing — UNOFFICIAL routes reverse-engineered from browser traffic, not part of the documented API. The documented public v2 API (networks, pools, tokens, OHLCV, trades, dexes, prices) is available under the /official/ prefix.

tags.name: jupiter_portfolio
tags.description: Solana portfolio and token data from Jupiter: aggregated DeFi positions across protocols (keyless v1 + extended per-adapter v2), staked JUP, indexed platform catalog, token search with verification and organic score, per-wallet USD price snapshots, the datapi wallet-PnL family (stats, token breakdown, activity, calendar, address summary, balance value, transfers, trades), the worker.jup.ag activity/staking reads, chain status, wallet risk screening, the Jupiter Lend token catalog, and the read-only Jupiter Swap quote (expected output amount, routed venues and price impact for an input/output mint and amount).

tags.name: kalshi
tags.description: Kalshi is a US-regulated event-contract (prediction-market) exchange: tradeable yes/no markets on politics, sports, crypto, economics, weather and culture. The default face is the live-validated web BFF surface (kalshi.com's frontend /v1 routes: enriched search, events/series/markets with nested markets, social, category pages, live data, forecast history). The documented public Trade API v2 (exchange status, order books, candlesticks, historical data, perpetuals market data) is available under the /official/ prefix.

tags.name: lifi
tags.description: Cross-chain routing and transfer data behind jumper.xyz: supported chains and tokens, aggregated bridge/exchange coverage, unsigned route plans with fees and ETA, gas-token suggestions, transfer status, the public transfer feed, Earn vault catalog, mission leaderboard and chart data. Reconstructed from the anonymous jumper.xyz frontend — its own routing pipeline and backend — not from any developer API.

tags.name: near_intents
tags.description: Service status, component and incident data for NEAR Intents, the cross-chain intents/bridge service (Cross-Chain Bridging, Solvers Network, Message Bus, deposit/withdrawal services, Explorer). The surface is the JSON API of the service's public status page status.near-intents.org, whose data the main page near-intents.org also renders: component (service) catalog, currently impacted components, incident/maintenance posts with updates, the status/severity vocabulary, and downtime/uptime matrices per component over a rolling window.

tags.name: oklink
tags.description: Multi-chain block explorer and analytics platform (OKX family). Covers 30+ blockchains: blocks, transactions, token transfers, address activity, NFT transfers, internal transactions, gas prices, and chain metadata. Data served from the web explorer API via reverse-engineered browser signing (x-apiKey over a browser-parity header set, curl_cffi transport).

tags.name: okxwallet
tags.description: Read-only OKX Wallet public reads: gas prices across supported chains, token metadata (symbol, supply, explorer, contract), contract-address resolution by coin id, and NFT holdings (owned/collected) keyed by a public address — plus the wallet-registered OKX DX swap-quote plane (route quotes, route+unsigned-calldata plans, compliance precheck, and on-chain ERC-20 allowance/approve reads) served through a registered mock OKX wallet identity (no private keys).

tags.name: polymarket
tags.description: Prediction-market discovery, events, market metadata, order books, prices/spreads, price history, public market holders, portfolio values, leaderboards and perpetual-market data. The facade routes each client-facing path to the correct Polymarket host internally (gamma / clob / data / perps), so callers never select a host. A small set of additional web-only public routes is available under the /web/ path prefix.

tags.name: rango
tags.description: Cross-chain bridge and DEX aggregator. This source covers the anonymous frontend API the public web app itself calls: supported blockchains, tokens and swappers metadata, route/quote discovery with per-route fees and ETAs, wallet balance lookups by address, and read-only transaction/approval status. Routes, methods and payloads come from live page traffic and the app's public bundle; no login, wallet connection or developer credential is involved.

tags.name: rubic
tags.description: Rubic cross-chain swap aggregator read surface: quoted routes and fees across the bridge/DEX providers the app lists (destination amount, minimum after slippage, USD value, ETA, price impact, gas estimate, provider type, routing hops), per-chain and per-provider operational status with execution-time statistics, token catalogs and prices per chain, token search, trending/gainers/losers, the private-transfer token list with per-token minimums, platform volume totals and cross-chain transaction status by source hash or Rubic trade id.

tags.name: skip_go
tags.description: Cross-chain swap/bridge routing data used by the go.skip.build frontend: the chain registry (104 entries incl. EVM/SVM with chain type, fee assets, IBC capabilities), the token registry keyed by chain id, the swap-venue registry, and a read-only route/quote computation returning the ordered operations, amount out, estimated fees, duration and required signatures for any source/destination asset pair.

tags.name: socket
tags.description: Cross-chain swap and bridge aggregation served by the public Bungee exchange frontend: supported chains with their bridge/DEX providers, per-chain token catalogs and symbol search, route discovery (output amounts, minimum received, estimated time, gas fee, provider, approval plan and unsigned transaction plan), and read-only quote/transaction status lookup.
